China Coast Guard Accused of Injuring Filipino Sailor in Disputed Waters

The Philippines has accused the Chinese coast guard of injuring a Filipino sailor during an incident near a disputed shoal. Video footage reportedly shows Chinese personnel deploying from a vessel. The incident highlights ongoing tensions in the South China Sea.
